title: God's Word ABCs Quiz
description: Let's see how well you know your letters and Bible words!

questions.question: What Bible word starts with the letter A?
questions.explanation: A is for Ark! God told Noah to build a big Ark to keep the animals safe (Genesis 6:14).

questions.question: What is the Bible?
questions.explanation: The Bible is God's special book! It tells us about God and how much He loves us. B is for Bible!

questions.question: What does Creation mean?
questions.explanation: Creation means everything God made — the sky, animals, trees, and people! C is for Creation (Genesis 1:1).

questions.question: Where was baby Moses found?
questions.explanation: Baby Moses was found in a basket on the river! A princess took care of him. M is for Moses (Exodus 2:10).

questions.question: Who is our Shepherd?
questions.explanation: God is our Shepherd! He takes care of us just like a shepherd takes care of sheep. S is for Shepherd (Psalm 23:1).
